summary: Authored a seven-phase implementation plan for the gate-skipped-plan-branch deadlock and the identical-redispatch loop. Adopts the research report's three corrections over the dispatch's own framing: the Gap 2 edit site is orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh (not skill-base.sh, which gets a comment-only fix), the corroboration overwrite must be gated on plan_markers_verified=true to avoid false-positive META_MISSING_AFTER_NARRATION records on ordinary Case 1 refusals, and handoff-schema.md must be corrected regardless of any schema addition. Adjacent items (a) new marker and (b) new defect-enum class are both explicitly decided OUT.
